title: Time Series Forecasting of Wind Energy Generation in Spain
subtitle: ARIMA-based forecasting and temporal analysis in R
description: Industrial time series forecasting project focused on modelling and predicting wind energy generation in Spain using ARIMA-based methods in R.
highlights: Developed a time series forecasting project in R using Spanish wind power generation data.
Applied temporal preprocessing, exploratory analysis and ARIMA-based forecasting methodology.
Evaluated the behaviour of wind energy generation over time and interpreted the forecasting performance.
Built a reproducible analytical workflow combining industrial data, statistical modeling and visualization.
